subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this experimental core Claws status/remove lifecycle, including automatic deletion of final unchanged Claw-origin packages and its durable ownership/recovery model?
rationale: The implementation now has no concrete review finding, but the open RFC, destructive behavior, persistent state contract, protected label, and unmerged stack make product and ownership acceptance a maintainer decision rather than an automated code-repair task.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked lifecycle
options.body: Approve the ownership and recovery semantics, land prerequisites in order, and merge this slice after final-main integration proof.

options.title: Land read-only status first
options.body: Retain lifecycle visibility while deferring package and file deletion until the destructive contract receives separate approval.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Keep the series open but unmerged while maintainers choose a different packaging or ownership direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked lifecycle
recommendation.body: Approve the ownership and recovery semantics, land prerequisites in order, and merge this slice after final-main integration proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent shared-state, config-mutation, and filesystem-safety history spans the durable and destructive boundaries requiring approval.
